steps.en: Generate Work Order triggers a check against PLUS
steps.id: Generate Work Order memicu pengecekan ke PLUS
steps.why_en: The button that would start the check does not exist.
steps.why_id: Tombol yang akan memulai pengecekan tidak ada.

steps.en: OCMS asks PLUS for recent appeals of the ID
steps.id: OCMS menanyakan ke PLUS appeal terbaru dari ID
steps.why_en: PLUS can call OCMS, but OCMS never asks PLUS for appeals.
steps.why_id: PLUS bisa memanggil OCMS, tetapi OCMS tidak pernah menanyakan appeal ke PLUS.

steps.en: The X-months window is a configurable parameter
steps.id: Window X bulan bisa diatur lewat parameter
steps.why_en: No appeal time-window parameter exists in the system.
steps.why_id: Parameter window waktu appeal tidak ada di sistem.

steps.en: OCMS gets the appeal address and appeal date
steps.id: OCMS mengambil alamat appeal dan tanggal appeal
steps.why_en: No code reads an address or date from a PLUS appeal.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang membaca alamat atau tanggal dari appeal PLUS.

steps.en: Appeal results appear as an on-screen listing
steps.id: Hasil appeal muncul sebagai listing di layar
steps.why_en: No screen shows appeal results for work order preparation.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar yang menampilkan hasil appeal untuk persiapan work order.
